title: One payment. Everyone’s share.
label: THE PRODUCT
text: A client pays your team. Who gets repaid first, and who gets what? TeamPay makes that agreement clear, then handles the split in USDC on Arc.

title: Expenses first. Shares next.
label: INTERACTIVE EXAMPLE · SIMULATED
text: Here, Ada covered sixty dollars in hosting. A small payment repays part of that cost. With three hundred dollars, her expense is repaid first. The rest follows the team's agreed shares.

title: Agree before anyone pays.
label: EDITABLE DRAFT · NO TRANSACTION
text: Create one agreement with your teammates, wallet addresses, expenses, and percentages. Preview where the money will go before publishing. Then share one payment link with your client.

title: Already working on Arc.
label: CONFIRMED MAINNET TEST
text: This is a completed mainnet test with two builder controlled wallets. Four payments totaled 0.006 USDC. The expense was repaid, and the rest split equally.

title: A receipt you can verify.
label: REAL TRANSACTION · PUBLIC RECEIPT
text: Each payment has a readable receipt, showing the recipients, amounts, and transaction link. Both teammates have withdrawn their earnings. Arc uses USDC for payments and network fees.

title: Make the split the easy part.
label: TRY TEAMPAY
text: TeamPay. One client payment, expenses repaid, and clear team shares. Try the example without a wallet, inspect the verified payment, or create your team's agreement.
